scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,worker,client -c gray,cyan,yellow,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run worker -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.worker: npm run build -w shared && npm run worker -w server
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.user:role: npm run build -w shared && npm run user:role -w server --
scripts.seed:demo: npm run build -w shared && npm run seed:demo -w server
